```python
for page in range(toc_pages):
    chrome(page+1)
    if not page:
        c.bookmarkPage('directory');c.addOutlineEntry('目录','directory',0)
    for j,groups_on_col in enumerate(toc_cols[page*2:page*2+2]):
        x=LM+j*(CW+GAP);y=TOP
        c.setFillColor(colors.black)
        draw('目录' if page==0 and j==0 else '目录（续）','CN',17,x,y)
        y-=36
        for g in groups_on_col:
            u=g['u']
            if g['ch_new']:
                c.setFillColor(colors.black)
                draw(f"{u['chapter_no']} {u['chapter']}",'CN',12,x,y);y-=23
            c.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#3b4855'))
            draw(f"{u['chapter_no']}.{u['group_no']} {u['group']}",'CN',10,x+4,y);y-=22
            for v,lines in g['entries']:
                y0=y
                c.setFillColor(colors.black)
                for line in lines:
                    draw(line,'CN',9,x+8,y);y-=13
                c.setFont('CN',9);c.drawRightString(x+CW,y0,str(starts[v['id']]))
                c.linkRect('',f"s{v['id']}",(x,y+2,x+CW,y0+11),relative=0,thickness=0)
                y-=3
        assert y>=BOT
    c.showPage()

seen=set();seen_ch=set();seen_group=set()
for page_idx,pg in enumerate(pages,toc_pages+1):
    chrome(page_idx)
    for j,col in enumerate(pg):
        x,y=LM+j*(CW+GAP),TOP
        if col and col[0]['role'] not in ('heading','breadcrumb'):
            u=units[col[0]['id']-1]
            c.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#626a72'))
            # Keep continuation titles inside the column even with long topic names.
            title='续 · '+u['number']+' '+u['title']
            while width(title,'CN',7)>CW:title=title[:-2]+'…'
            draw(title,'CN',7,x,TOP+12)
        for t in col:
            ident=t['id'];u=units[ident-1]
            if ident not in seen:
                c.bookmarkHorizontalAbsolute(f's{ident}',y+12)
                ch=u['chapter_no'];group=(ch,u['group_no'])
                if ch not in seen_ch:
                    c.bookmarkHorizontalAbsolute(f'ch{ch}',y+12)
                    c.addOutlineEntry(f"{ch} {u['chapter']}",f'ch{ch}',0);seen_ch.add(ch)
                if group not in seen_group:
                    dest=f'g{ch}_{u["group_no"]}'
                    c.bookmarkHorizontalAbsolute(dest,y+12)
                    c.addOutlineEntry(f"{ch}.{u['group_no']} {u['group']}",dest,1);seen_group.add(group)
                c.addOutlineEntry(u['number']+' '+u['title'],f's{ident}',2);seen.add(ident)
            if t['role'] in ('code','comment'):
                c.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#f3f4f5'))
                c.rect(x-3,y-2.5,CW+3,t['lead'],fill=1,stroke=0)
            c.setFillColor(colors.HexColor('#45564d') if t['role']=='comment' else
                           colors.HexColor('#626a72') if t['role']=='breadcrumb' else colors.black)
            if t['role']=='formula':draw_formula(t['txt'],x,y)
            elif t['size']:draw(t['txt'],t['font'],t['size'],x,y)
            if t.get('url'):c.linkURL(t['url'],(x,y-2,x+min(CW,width(t['txt'],t['font'],t['size'])),y+t['size']),relative=0,thickness=0)
            y-=t['lead']
    c.showPage()
c.save()
report=dict(pages=total,toc_pages=toc_pages,sheets=math.ceil(total/2),topics=len(units),
            chapters=len(seen_ch),groups=len(seen_group),starts=starts,
            column_heights=[round(h,2) for h in heights],code_size=CODE,body_size=BODY,formulas=sum(len(u.get('formulas',[])) for u in units),formula_topics=sum(bool(u.get('formulas')) for u in units))
(ROOT/'.maintenance/layout_report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k not in ('starts','column_heights')},ensure_ascii=False))
```

## .maintenance/check_contest_book.py

```python
from pathlib import Path
import re,json,subprocess,concurrent.futures,hashlib
from build_contest_book import source_text
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'.maintenance/book_sources.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
manifest=[u for u in manifest if u['kind']!='reference']
md=(ROOT/'07_比赛板子/算法竞赛板子.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
f=chr(96)*3
blocks=re.findall(f+'cpp\n(.*?)\n'+f,md,re.S)
assert len(blocks)==len(manifest)
tmp=ROOT/'.maintenance/book_units'
tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def check(it):
    i,code=it
    unit=manifest[i-1]
    i=unit['id']
    assert code==source_text(unit),(i,'source differs')
    src=tmp/f'{i:02d}.cpp'
    wrapper=('#include <bits/stdc++.h>\nusing namespace std;\n'+code+'\nint main(){}\n') if unit['kind'] in ('snippet','function') else code
    src.write_text(wrapper,encoding='utf-8')
    z=subprocess.run(['D:/tdm64-gcc/bin/g++.exe','-std=c++14',*(['-pedantic-errors'] if '__int128' not in code else []),'-O2',
                      str(src),*(['-c'] if unit['kind']=='interface' else []),'-o',str(tmp/(f'{i:02d}.o' if unit['kind']=='interface' else f'{i:02d}.exe'))],
                      capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
    assert z.returncode==0,(i,z.stderr)
    return dict(id=i,key=unit['key'],title=unit['title'],source=unit['source'],
                kind=unit['kind'],same_source=True,compile=True,warnings=z.stderr,
                sha256=hashlib.sha256(code.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest())
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    result=list(pool.map(check,enumerate(blocks,1)))
(ROOT/'.maintenance/book_check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(f'{len(result)} exact source comparisons and C++14 compilations passed')
```

## .maintenance/book_behavior_support.py

```python
"""Prepare concrete legacy sources used by behavior checks, including references."""
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from build_contest_book import source_text

def prepare_reference_sources(root, current, legacy):
    by_source={u['source']:u for u in current}
    seen=set()
    for old in legacy:
        u=by_source[old['source']]
        if u['kind']!='reference' or u['id'] in seen:continue
        seen.add(u['id'])
        unit=dict(u,kind=old.get('kind','program'))
        code=source_text(unit)
        path=Path(root)/'.maintenance/book_units'/f'{u["id"]:02d}.cpp'
        path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(code,encoding='utf-8')
        result=subprocess.run(['D:/tdm64-gcc/bin/g++.exe','-std=c++14','-O2',str(path),'-o',str(path.with_suffix('.exe'))],capture_output=True,text=True)
        assert result.returncode==0,(u['source'],result.stderr)
```

```python
from pathlib import Path
import json,re
from urllib.parse import unquote
from pypdf import PdfReader
from matplotlib.textpath import TextPath
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
units=json.loads((ROOT/'.maintenance/book_sources.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
layout=json.loads((ROOT/'.maintenance/layout_report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
md=(ROOT/'07_比赛板子/算法竞赛板子.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
f=chr(96)*3
def normalize_formula(tex):
    return (re.sub(r'\\le\b',r'\\leq',tex)
            .replace(r'\neq',r'\ne')
            .replace(r'\Longleftrightarrow',r'\Leftrightarrow')
            .replace(r'\iff',r'\Leftrightarrow')
            .replace(r'\mathbin{\&}',r'\;\mathrm{AND}\;')
            .replace(r'\bmod',r'\;\mathrm{mod}\;')
            .replace(r'\text{ 从大到小}',r'\mathrm{descending}')
            .replace(r'\operatorname{ans}',r'\mathrm{ans}')
            .replace(r'\frac{m(m+1)}2',r'\frac{m(m+1)}{2}'))
chapters={u['chapter_no'] for u in units}
groups={(u['chapter_no'],u['group_no']) for u in units}
code_units=[u for u in units if u['kind']!='reference']
assert md.count(f+'cpp')==len(code_units)
assert len(units)==layout['topics']
assert len(re.findall(r'^### \d+ ',md,re.M))==len(chapters)==layout['chapters']
assert len(re.findall(r'^- \*\*\d+\.\d+ ',md,re.M))==len(groups)==layout['groups']
plain=re.sub(f+r'cpp\n.*?\n'+f,'',md,flags=re.S)
for term in ('原稿','原注','查阅顺序','个人习惯','打印说明','2025汕头大学','全部题面'):
    assert term not in plain,term
for heading in re.findall(r'^## .*$',plain,re.M):
    assert 'Fibonacci' not in heading and '斐波那契' not in heading,heading
pages=(ROOT/'tmp/pdfs/final/text.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('\f')
assert len(pages)-1==layout['pages']
pdf=PdfReader(ROOT/'output/pdf/acm_cpp14_contest_cheatsheet.pdf')
logical_pages={}
normalize=lambda s:re.sub(r'\s+','',s)
for u in units:
    page=layout['starts'][str(u['id'])]
    wanted=normalize(u['number']+' '+u['title'])
    if page not in logical_pages:logical_pages[page]=normalize(pdf.pages[page-1].extract_text())
    assert wanted in logical_pages[page],(u['id'],page,wanted)
    assert f"第 {page} 页](#part{u['id']:02d})" in md,u['id']
    section=md.split(f"<!-- section {u['id']} -->")[1].split('<!-- section ')[0]
    assert section.index('题目描述')<section.index('例题与代码')<section.index('变式例题')<section.index('关键说明')
    assert (ROOT/u['source']).is_file()
    if u['kind']!='reference':
        assert section.index('关键说明')<section.index(f+'cpp')
    else:
        assert f+'cpp' not in section
    if u['formulas']:
        assert section.index('关键说明')<section.index('核心公式')
        if u['kind']!='reference':assert section.index('核心公式')<section.index(f+'cpp')
    assert re.findall(r'\$\$\n(.*?)\n\$\$',section,re.S)==u['formulas']
    for tex in u['formulas']:
        box=TextPath((0,0),'$'+normalize_formula(tex)+'$',size=11.5).get_extents()
        assert box.width>0 and box.height>0
        scale=min(1,((210-26-7)/2*72/25.4-12)/box.width)
        assert scale*11.5>=8,(u['id'],tex)
for p in (ROOT/'07_比赛板子').glob('*.md'):
    if p.name=='维护与校验.md':continue
    content=re.sub(f+r'cpp\n.*?\n'+f,'',p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),flags=re.S)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',content):
        if target.startswith(('http','#')):continue
        assert (p.parent/unquote(target)).exists(),(p,target)
pdf=PdfReader(ROOT/'output/pdf/acm_cpp14_contest_cheatsheet.pdf')
assert len(pdf.pages)==layout['pages']
assert all(abs(float(p.mediabox.width)-595.276)<.01 and abs(float(p.mediabox.height)-841.89)<.01 for p in pdf.pages)
links=[a.get_object() for p in pdf.pages[:layout['toc_pages']] for a in p.get('/Annots',[])]
links=[a for a in links if a.get('/Subtype')=='/Link']
assert len(links)==len(units)
page_ids={p.indirect_reference.idnum:i+1 for i,p in enumerate(pdf.pages)}
for u,link in zip(units,links):
    assert page_ids[link['/Dest'][0].idnum]==layout['starts'][str(u['id'])],u['id']
def flatten(items):
    for item in items:
        if isinstance(item,list):yield from flatten(item)
        else:yield item
assert len(list(flatten(pdf.outline)))==1+len(chapters)+len(groups)+len(units)
assert pdf.trailer['/Root']['/ViewerPreferences']['/Duplex']=='/DuplexFlipLongEdge'
report=dict(topics=len(units),chapters=len(chapters),groups=len(groups),pages=len(pdf.pages),
            toc_links=len(links),formulas=sum(len(u['formulas']) for u in units),passed=True)
(ROOT/'.maintenance/book_layout_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
```
